name: Rim Runners
source:
Rex Leinster is a young man from the remote, backwater planet Earth, who dreams of one day exploring and adventuring throughout space just like his father. He enters a local space race hoping to earn a bit of money and fame for himself, but winds up losing by a hair. However, his performance attracts the attention of a recruiter for the Lightning Express shipping company, and soon he's hired on as their newest cargo pilot.

[Taken from [url=http://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPS-25393.html]PlayStation DataCenter[/url]]
translation:
雷克斯·伦斯特 (Rex Leinster) 是一位来自遥远偏僻的地球的年轻人，他梦想有一天能像他的父亲一样在太空中探索和冒险。他参加了当地的一场太空竞赛，希望为自己赚点钱和名气，但最终以微弱优势落败。然而，他的表现引起了闪电快运运输公司招聘人员的注意，很快他就被聘为他们最新的货运飞行员。

[取自 [url=http://psxdatacenter.com/psx2/games2/SLPS-25393.html]PlayStation DataCenter[/url]]
